notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four other Shrines.
description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.
